text:
Everything is inevitable. Drowning the light there rises,

powerful and tenacious, the nightmare.

In the light body heaviness beats:

a sea of shadows overflows

from the immortal shore to our shore.

But I write verses in search of clarities.


And knowing the faith of my verse, without hesitating I affirm

the absolute meaning of life

on a meaningless earth.




1951

translation.title: Everything Is Inevitable. Drowning the Light There Rises...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the affirmative claim of meaning on a meaningless earth.
